scope: Acquisition of previous-year Telangana Police SI / Constable question papers and their answers.
expected_justification: No source or paper set has been enumerated, because this environment could reach no paper-hosting host (egress allowlist) and web search returned no content. expected will become a counted figure with a recorded basis once a source is verified; it is not an estimate.
blocked_reason: Network egress from this environment is restricted to an allowlist that does not include any paper-hosting host (see source_material/pyq_raw/RETRIEVAL_LOG.md). Per D-0017 the refusal is recorded verbatim and not routed around.
notes: A coaching-site copy of a paper is a legitimate T2_HISTORICAL_PYQ source, but is recorded with source_type COACHING_COPY and is never relabelled as a board document.
A paper reconstructed from candidate recall must be labelled CANDIDATE_RECALL and cross-checked against at least one other source before any question is classified.
